Also the 0DTE ATM-straddle expected mo

tools.name: get_regime
tools.description: Current SPX dealer regime label + confidence only.

tools.name: list_history_dates
tools.description: Available historical SPX market-structure replay dates.

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: Per-day SPX market-structure timeline + summary for one replay date (YYYY-MM-DD). Data only -- not investment advice or a trade recommendation.

tools.name: get_regime_segments
tools.description: Compressed dealer-regime segment tape for one replay date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: subscribe_event
tools.description: Subscribe a callback URL to a market-structure event (zero_gamma_flip | new_wall | regime_transition).

tools.name: unsubscribe
tools.description: Remove an event subscription by id.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List this agent's active event subscriptions.

tools.name: get_field_guide
tools.description: Static, versioned dictionary of every field this surface emits: unit, value set where the producer has one, and a one-sentence meaning, plus the shared response conventions (tier, delay, timestamps, and how missing data is reported). No inputs; call once per session.
